summary: Master mortgage financing, underwriting, and market analysis. Learn Basel IV, IFRS 9, and digital lending strategies to optimize your portfolio. Enroll today.
lede: Mortgage market analysis examines lending products, borrower risk and economic forces that influence property-backed finance. For professionals assessing mortgage applications or managing residential and commercial lending portfolios, the course develops skills in evaluating borrower credit and property collateral, comparing financing structures, and stress-testing portfolios against market shocks.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the stability and growth of residential and commercial lending portfolios.
modules: Global Mortgage Market Dynamics and Drivers
Residential and Commercial Financing Product Structures
Advanced Underwriting and Credit Risk Assessment
Property Valuation and Collateral Risk Management
Digital Mortgage Ecosystems and Fintech Integration
ESG Integration and Green Mortgage Financing
Mortgage Portfolio Optimization and Stress Testing
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in banking, credit analysis, or real estate finance. A basic understanding of financial statements and interest rate mechanics is required. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is highly recommended.
